findings.detail: A malformed UTF-8 session file escaped _read_records as UnicodeDecodeError and crashed show --json. The decoder error is now wrapped in SessionFileError and session probing preserves that concrete read refusal.
The first probe change also changed malformed JSON from not-a-session to cannot-read. The final code re-raises only read failures, preserving the historical malformed-JSON classification.

reviewed_evidence: Red first: test_show_json_refuses_malformed_utf8_without_touching_input raised UnicodeDecodeError before the implementation.
After the fix: the same test returns exit 2, one session_file JSON object on stdout, empty stderr, no traceback, and unchanged input bytes.
Compatibility regression: tests/test_sessions.py ran 77 tests OK, including malformed JSON remaining a not-a-session refusal.
CLI JSON tests ran 7 tests OK; PocketChat documentation guard ran 16 tests OK; ruff E9/F and git diff --check passed.
The implementation is limited to the session-record read boundary and the session-file probe; no command surface or format version changed.
